description: USFS Climate Gallery - Climate Change and Adaptation: New England and Northern New York Forests StoryMap is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFS Office of Sustainability and Climate; Northern Institute of Applied Climate Science. Forests cover more than 40 million acres across New England and northern New York, from the coast of the Atlantic Ocean to the peaks of the Appalachian Mountains. These forests deliver many benefits to people of this region, including clean air and water, fish and wildlife, and places for families to spend time outdoors. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
